doc.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996

title: Upcoming Florida Pops dates with Skitch Henderson
summary: He is going to Florida to play Pops concerts for his old friend Skitch Henderson.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What’s in the immediate future for you after you leave here?
I have to ask my wife. Sharon, what am I doing? SR: You’re going to Florida.

Scratch Anderson. I’m doing the Florida Pops, Skitch Henderson is the conductor of many pops orchestras. He does the New York Pops and so forth. He’s an old friend and has never forgotten it, and I’ve never forgotten it. When he calls me I say yes. I don’t even ask what it is. And he’s always been a good guy. He likes music. I never ask how much, because I will do it anyway. And so he’s got Walt Levinsky, myself, a bass player, he couldn’t get Hag I think so I recommended somebody I knew down there, a young guy that he didn’t know. I said this guy plays good, don’t worry about it, I’ll shepherd him through. And who else? Is that it? I don’t think Bucky’s there. But we’re doing some pops things — Clearwater, St. Pete and Tampa. And I love warm weather anyway, so I’m looking forward to going down there.
